about.title: About me
about.bio:
Full Stack Developer and Information Systems Engineer (UTN-FRRe) focusing on React, Node.js, and TypeScript.

I developed and deployed a complete web platform for the UTN-FRRe Secretariat of Science and Technology, covering everything from REST API design to UI implementation. Additionally, I was part of the core team behind Elepad, a social impact mobile app published on the Google Play Store.

I am passionate about building efficient solutions using agile methodologies and DevOps culture (Docker, CI/CD, Cloud). I am currently looking to join a team where I can build real products, learn quickly, and add value.

elepad.title: Elepad — Mobile App for Senior Citizens
elepad.description: Mobile application published on Google Play Store for cognitive stimulation, daily routines, and intergenerational connection.
elepad.long_description: Developed a mobile application published on the Google Play Store for cognitive stimulation, daily routines, and intergenerational connection. Project originated from a winning proposal at the Latin American Innovation Rally 2024 (3rd place, Social Impact).
features: Stack: React Native + Expo (iOS/Android/Web), TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers (serverless backend), Supabase (JWT + Google OAuth auth, storage, PostgreSQL)
Monorepo architecture with Turborepo, CI/CD with GitHub Actions (7 releases under Scrum)
Features: adaptive calendar, cognitive games, shared memory gallery, statistics, and family monitoring
Team of 5 people — Final Degree Project in Information Systems Engineering

scyt-utn.title: SCyT Platform — UTN FRRe
scyt-utn.description: Web platform for centralizing administrative processes and tracking research projects.
scyt-utn.long_description: Designed and developed the web platform for centralizing administrative processes and tracking research projects under the Manuel Belgrano Scholarship, accredited as a Supervised Professional Practice (PPS).
features: Dynamic interfaces with React.js, ChakraUI, and TanStack Query, including complex state management
RESTful API with Node.js and Express under multi-layer architecture (controllers, services, repositories)
PostgreSQL database with Prisma ORM, including migrations and query performance optimizations
Secure authentication using JWT and password hashing (bcrypt)
Continuous deployment in cloud environment (Render) with CI/CD

devops-kubernetes.title: DevOps: Kubernetes & Observability
devops-kubernetes.description: Kubernetes orchestration, high availability, and full observability with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.
devops-kubernetes.long_description: Academic project implementing Kubernetes (K3d) orchestration with full observability configuration and resilience validation.
features: Kubernetes orchestration (K3d): 1 control-plane + 2 workers, with 2 backend replicas and podAntiAffinity
Full observability: OpenTelemetry → Tempo (traces), Prometheus (metrics), Grafana (dashboards)
Custom metrics: RPS, p95/p50 latency, CPU, memory, restarts
Resilience validation through resource saturation

devops-azure.title: DevOps: Containerization & CI/CD on Azure
devops-azure.description: Web application containerization and CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions for Azure deployment.
devops-azure.long_description: Containerized a web application (Next.js frontend, Flask backend, Redis cache) with Docker and Docker Compose, with a complete CI/CD pipeline on Azure.
features: Containerization with Docker and Docker Compose (Next.js + Flask + Redis)
CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions: automatic build, push to Azure Container Registry
Deploy to Azure Container Instances
Decoupled service architecture communicating via REST API

data-warehouse.title: Data Warehouse & BI: Record Label
data-warehouse.description: Complete Business Intelligence solution with ETL, OLAP cubes, and interactive Power BI dashboards.
data-warehouse.long_description: Designed a complete BI solution for a record label with 3 fact tables, ETL, OLAP, and interactive dashboards.
features: 3 fact tables (Sales, Contracts, Productions) handling Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
ETL processes with SSIS for data integration and transformation
OLAP cubes with SSAS for multidimensional analysis
Power BI dashboards: ROI by artist/record, unmet demand, revenue by region, temporal analysis

play-finder.title: Play Finder — Sports Booking Management
play-finder.description: Full Stack web application for managing and booking sports facilities.
play-finder.long_description: Developed a Full Stack web application for managing and booking sports facilities as an ADUSI Capstone Project, with a team of 7 people under Scrum methodology.
features: Full Stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL
Layered architecture, robust authentication (JWT and Google OAuth)
Containerized deployment with Docker on Azure
Team of 7 people under Scrum methodology — entire software lifecycle
